# milo

> milo provides small terminal panes for a live file tree, Git history, usage, and a read-only file reader. The panes work on their own or alongside your shell in Rex.

milo does not write to the project it displays. The v0.1.3 prebuilt release is for Apple Silicon macOS. Use `brew install mcc0x/milo/milo` or the release installer below. Building from source requires Rust 1.91 or later and Git. The Rust crate depends only on `libc`.

## Using milo

- [Full documentation](https://usemilo.net/llms-full.txt): The main-branch guides and agent instructions in one text file.
- [README](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo#readme): Installation, a picture of each pane and the main commands.
- [Release installer](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/releases/download/v0.1.3/install.sh): Downloads the v0.1.3 binary from GitHub, verifies its SHA-256 checksum and installs it without a toolchain.
- [Source installer](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/install.sh): Builds milo with Cargo and installs or removes the binary. It does not change Rex or Claude Code settings.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/skills/milo/SKILL.md): How to check milo and open a reader in the user's terminal, including at a Git commit.
- [Setup and removal](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/docs/setup.md): Rex actions, new shell tabs and the Claude Code status line.
- [Keys and marks](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/docs/keys.md): Keyboard shortcuts and what the panes show.
- [Usage limits](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/docs/usage.md): Where the figures come from and what they mean.
- [Using the panes](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/docs/panes.md): Pane sizes, history and the file reader.

## Developing milo

- [Contributing](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Build and test instructions, repository safety rules, and source map.
- [Cargo manifest](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/Cargo.toml): Rust version, dependencies, license, and release profile.
- [Command entry point](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/src/main.rs): Command syntax, CLI help and dispatch.
- [Pane loop](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/src/pane.rs): Input, redraws and checks for file changes.
- [Rex setup](https://github.com/mcc0x/milo/blob/main/src/setup.rs): Layout choices and the save preview.
